values.reopens: after post-storm assessments; no date announced
values.note: NPS alert 2026-10-21: 'The Cape Point and Frisco campgrounds and several off-road vehicle routes are currently closed. Reopening will begin after conditions improve and post-storm assessments are complete.'

status.source: NPS alert 'Cape Point & Frisco campgrounds and several ORV ramps remain closed' (developer.nps.gov/api/v1/alerts?parkCode=caha, dated 2026-10-21), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Shortened reservation window: recreation.gov opens sites 4 days ahead (NPS: 'Campsite reservations are limited to same-day reservations only'), because the low-lying campground floods and 'Reservations may be canceled with limited notice'. Camping is limited to 14 days in total between Easter and Thanksgiving.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251945 (rules reservationWindow 4 Days, maxStay 14 nights; 'Cape Point Campground sites have a shortened reservation window'; 'Camping is limited to a total of 14 days of camping between Easter Day and Thanksgiving Day'; 'Reservations only via Recreation.gov') + https://www.nps.gov/caha/planyourvisit/campgrounds.htm (and the NPS campground record behind it, developer.nps.gov/api/v1/campgrounds?parkCode=caha) ('Campsite reservations are limited to same-day reservations only. Campsites must be booked via recreation.gov'; numberOfSitesFirstComeFirstServe 0), read 2026-10-21

values.note: NPS: 'Open spring-late fall'; winter closure 2026-11-28 to 2027-04-02. Opening dates vary by year (rate seasons began Mar 26 for 2027).

season.source: https://www.nps.gov/caha/planyourvisit/campgrounds.htm (and the NPS campground record behind it, developer.nps.gov/api/v1/campgrounds?parkCode=caha) (operatingHours exception 'Winter closure' 2026-11-28 to 2027-04-02; 'Open spring-late fall'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 202 sites, 49 of them tent-only (rows D-F); NPS gives 40 ft total vehicle length at all sites, though the catalog lists pads of 40-50 ft. RVs over 25 ft may have to park a second vehicle in auxiliary parking.

sites.source: https://www.nps.gov/caha/planyourvisit/campgrounds.htm (and the NPS campground record behind it, developer.nps.gov/api/v1/campgrounds?parkCode=caha) (totalSites 202, tentOnly 49; 'The maximum total vehicle length is 40' at all sites') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251945 ('Rows D, E, and F are reserved for tent camping only'; 'large RVs over 25 feet may have to park second vehicles in auxiliary parking') + recreation.gov campsite catalog for 251945 (RIDB, fetched 2026-10-20) (Max Vehicle Length 40-50), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251945 ('There are no hook-ups in the campground for RVs'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251945 ('Four sets of restrooms and outdoor shower facilities'; 'Water spigots providing potable water') + https://www.nps.gov/caha/planyourvisit/campgrounds.htm (and the NPS campground record behind it, developer.nps.gov/api/v1/campgrounds?parkCode=caha) ('unheated showers'; toilets 'Flush Toilets - seasonal'; dumpStation 'Yes - seasonal'; 'A dump and water fill station are located back up Lighthouse Road'; campStore 'No'), read 2026-10-21

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251945/rates (2026 and 2027 seasons: STANDARD NONELECTRIC $20) + https://www.nps.gov/caha/planyourvisit/campgrounds.htm (and the NPS campground record behind it, developer.nps.gov/api/v1/campgrounds?parkCode=caha) (Camp Site cost 20.00), read 2026-10-21

discounts.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251945 ('The Access Pass and both the Senior Annual and Senior Lifetime Pass are the only passes that provide a discount on the fee for the campsite physically occupied by the pass owner'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Currently CLOSED (NPS alert 2026-10-21, post-storm); confirmed $20, recreation.gov only with a 4-day window, no FCFS, 14-day Easter-Thanksgiving limit, no hookups, flush toilets/cold showers/water/dump; added season Apr 3-Nov 27 (2026), 202 sites (49 tent), 40 ft.
flags: Temporarily closed: NPS alert dated 2026-10-21 'The Cape Point and Frisco campgrounds and several off-road vehicle routes are currently closed. Reopening will begin after conditions improve and post-storm assessments are complete.' Recorded as status temporarily_closed; the seasonal winter closure starts Nov 28 anyway.
inclusion_evidence says '25 ft max'; NPS gives 40 ft total vehicle length at all sites (25 ft is only the point past which a second vehicle may have to park elsewhere). Fits a 23-ft rig either way.
